_note: Kid-friendly food facts based on the Canadian Space Agency (CSA) toolkit 'Food production on the Moon and in remote areas'. Collected 2026-11-14; fetch-data.mjs re-checks each quote. Credit: Canadian Space Agency.

toolkit.title: Toolkit for educators and youth – Food production on the Moon and in remote areas

facts.en: Astronauts on the ISS get fresh food shipped up every few months. Far away on the Moon or Mars, deliveries will be rare, or even impossible!
facts.pt: Os astronautas da ISS recebem comida fresca a cada poucos meses. Longe, na Lua ou em Marte, as entregas serão raras, ou até impossíveis!
facts.quote: Greater distances will make resupply trips less frequent or impossible.

facts.en: Fresh food adds variety and nutrition, which keep crews healthy AND happy.
facts.pt: Comida fresca traz variedade e nutrientes, que deixam a tripulação saudável E feliz.
facts.quote: important factors in keeping crewmembers healthy and happy

facts.en: Space travellers going far will need ‘green thumbs’ to grow their own food.
facts.pt: Quem viajar para longe no espaço vai precisar ter ‘mão boa’ para plantar a própria comida.
facts.quote: will need to develop "green thumbs" to grow their own food in space

facts.en: Space food must be small and light, but also nutritious and tasty!
facts.pt: Comida espacial precisa ser pequena e leve, mas também nutritiva e gostosa!
facts.quote: Space food must be compact and lightweight, as well as nutritious and tasty!

facts.en: The Deep Space Food Challenge looked for food systems that need very few inputs: materials, energy and water. That is why your greenhouse costs power!
facts.pt: O Desafio de Comida para o Espaço Profundo buscou sistemas que gastem pouquíssimos recursos: materiais, energia e água. Por isso sua estufa gasta energia!
facts.quote: require minimal inputs (materials, energy, water, etc.)

facts.en: Crews on long missions will likely have to produce food in space to meet their nutrition needs.
facts.pt: Tripulações em missões longas provavelmente vão ter que produzir comida no espaço para se alimentar bem.
facts.quote: Crews will likely have to produce food in space to meet their nutritional needs.

facts.en: The winning CANGrow system could grow over 700 kg of healthy food per year!
facts.pt: O sistema vencedor CANGrow pode produzir mais de 700 kg de comida saudável por ano!
facts.quote: the potential to generate over 700 kg of nutrient-dense food annually

facts.en: Canada is preparing advanced food production systems for the surface of the Moon, to feed the astronauts of the future.
facts.pt: O Canadá está preparando sistemas avançados de produção de comida para a superfície da Lua, para alimentar os astronautas do futuro.
facts.quote: advanced food production systems on the surface of the Moon
facts.check: food production systems on the surface of the Moon
